## Automatic OPS-TIME gate

- [ ] Canonical GPT labor policy and planning policy read from `slavagrachov/software-governance/main`
- [ ] Project, Issue, WP, and Execution Cycle resolved
- [ ] Plan/Fact row identified
- [ ] Collector API/status/version/conversation preflight passed
- [ ] `OPS-TIME START GATE — PASS` recorded

## Execution and reconciliation

- [ ] One measurable substantive response per WP where practicable
- [ ] First next turn reconciles the preceding substantive response
- [ ] Event identity proven by event/message identity, not timestamp alone
- [ ] Context and labor-purpose classification resolved independently
- [ ] Governance/control work excluded from WP FACT
- [ ] Missing evidence leaves FACT empty after one bounded pass

## Closeout

- [ ] Qualified substantive FACT reported
- [ ] Governance overhead reported separately
- [ ] Issue-scope unallocated labor reported separately
- [ ] Coverage/conflicts/evidence gaps disclosed
- [ ] `Issue Substantive FACT = Σ qualified child WP FACT` verified
